how: Calls recruit members for local figures, names and timed placing without establishing completion of every proposed work.
Members propose and compare a face, lettering, sites and alternatives for a local tribute.
Members report joining the badge build and later declare it done, while the separate Dan effort has only a reported outline.
The badge template and Dan coordinates offer concrete locations and instructions for contributors.
Members try to keep the reference alive, warn of griefing and call to hold the drawing.
A member refuses to ruin a proposed target flag, and another promises no expansion beyond a border.
Neighbours contest prior occupation and negotiate a black border and a cordoned section.
Building over the Swedish flag is proposed by one member, with no evidence that the proposal was executed.
Members thank helpers, celebrate the made reference and claim contributions.
Members mark closure, report survival and recount a failed personal attempt.
A member directly answers the badge call with a bare join and reports working downward from the top right.
A neighbour agrees to requested help and a later reply reports promised protection from another group.
The member posting the badge proposal and template gives another member a concrete project to join.
Explicit April Fools reveals and acknowledgement establish playful host framing beside the separate repeated-image joke.
Existing fandom names and recognised streamer imagery supply the proposed marks without requiring national or colour allegiance.
An alliance suggestion and protection report warrant a minimal reported arrangement, while sustained reciprocal defence and coalition organisation remain unverified.
The cited warnings and fate report provide no investigation tracing placers or identifying friendly fire.
Neither the failed personal attempt nor unfinished Dan discussion documents relocation after loss of a room work.
The end and failed-attempt accounts contain no decision to carry the collective effort into another canvas or lasting institution.
Repair and holding are documented without evidence about placement automation or spare accounts.
Territorial argument and survival celebration do not document a continuing rival-room exchange of taunts or victory claims.
An egg proposed on another flag does not establish host permission, guest status or authority over the site.
The posting complaint concerns repeated Jedi images and cannot establish moderation or containment of canvas calls.
Border disputes and promises do not show disagreement over anyone's authority to bind all placers.
The pre-close credit correction and later survival report do not show post-close cleanup or a contest over the retained record.
A failed personal attempt and colour question do not establish a collective diagnosis of inadequate hands or space.
The proposed target flag and border dispute do not name a quarrel inherited from before the canvas.
Self-selected work and attribution to an unseen organising chat cannot establish whether that group decided leadership, voting or a division of work.
Fandom identity and an encroachment proposal do not establish that a pre-canvas tie selected the rival.
A local contact report does not identify an individual carrying a proposal between both venues.
The author's Dan call receives an explicit update reporting a rough outline, while the badge call directly receives a report of joining.
Starting and calling coincide in the proposal another member joins, so a distinct starter stage before recruitment is not required.
The thanks-and-hold post explicitly makes keeping the made drawing the next task.
Repair of existing work overlaps further building, so upkeep need not wait for the whole project to be declared complete.
A repair appeal receives an encroachment challenge, so disputed occupation must supplement erosion as the explanation for the ensuing border talk.
The dispute elicits a border promise, but compliance by all placers cannot be inferred from that speech commitment.
Visible upkeep and an unseen organising venue leave any transition to scripts or spare accounts undecidable.
The post thanks helpers for the made drawing and receives a made-work celebration, supporting accomplishment followed by collective marking.
Celebration precedes a fate report, but no cited turn attributes recording to celebration and a timelapse already served live territorial argument.
The closure and failure accounts do not show recording leading to a decision about future collective work.
A failed personal attempt supplies neither a collective scarcity diagnosis nor a linked decision to relocate.
A posted template and unresolved design objections do not establish that argument produced an agreed template settling the design.
The badge call receives a direct bare acceptance reporting participation without a request in return.
Seeking protection and reporting a promise under upkeep strain do not by themselves establish that the other room delivered help.
The border conversation becomes an agreed request for help against a newly named expanding neighbour.
An agreed request establishes willingness to help, while actual exchanged placements require evidence beyond assent.
Recruitment permits an encroachment suggestion, but the documented response is reluctance to damage the flag rather than evidence of an executed raid.
The proposal to build over a flag receives a direct refusal grounded in not wanting to ruin that flag.
An accusation of encroachment can elicit a border promise without an admitted attack call.
The observed answer to the target-flag proposal is restraint, with no documented transition into a rival-room taunting contest.
A request for an alliance and reported protection do not establish that the groups subsequently defended together.
Canvas calls, removed planning bodies and a complaint about another posting joke cannot identify a causal route from recruiting to canvas moderation.
Territorial negotiation is observed without a subsequent dispute about who can commit all placers to its agreement.
Distinguish the public recruiting and reporting venue from the building group named in a participant's correction of collective credit.
Keep a mockup's proposed subject distinct from implementable design when participants challenge its unavailable colours.
Public credit can be corrected to identify builders in another venue while acknowledging the recruiting venue's contribution.
Separate the repeated-image prank from canvas invitations unless a passage connects the joking to pixel work.

statement: explaining the canvas during ongoing work
how: Questions and direct explanations make the event intelligible while recruitment and building already proceed, rather than necessarily preceding them.

statement: showing and locating a canvas find without claiming it
how: A found picture is located for viewers without identifying its owner or claiming the room made or adopted it.
